frozen: 2026-10-29, after the counts-only feasibility (results/FEASIBILITY.json) and before any price was read or any feature computed
owner_instruction: go build ... everything else (handoff/github-finds/PLAN_v1.md section 3; PLAN_v2 rank 3)
question: For an organised pump on a Binance BTC pair, can the machine rank the pumped pair among every BTC pair trading at the time, better than ranking by trading volume alone, (a) at the end of the previous UTC day and (b) one hour before the pump hour?

events.sources: SOURCES.json (three lists, each pinned by sha256)
events.definition: one event per (pair, UTC date), Binance, BTC quote; time = the earliest time any list states; pump hour H = that time floored to the hour
events.feasibility: 1,413 events 2018-01-03..2022-02-02; 1,383 with hourly archive bars; 265 distinct pairs

prices.source: Binance public archive, data.binance.vision, spot monthly 1h klines of every BTC pair, months 2017-07..2022-02 only; each zip checked against its .CHECKSUM
prices.store: build.py converts each pair to data/raw/binance_pumps/<PAIR>.npz (git-ignored) and records every file's sha256 in results/PRICE_MANIFEST.json

cutoffs.DAILY: 00:00 UTC of the event date (what a daily routine could know)
cutoffs.HOURLY: H - 1h: only bars that closed at or before H - 1h

candidates: every BTC pair with a bar in the 24 hours before the cut-off and at least 7 days of bars before it; an event whose pumped pair is not a candidate is dropped and counted

SIZE.lv7: log(1 + BTC quote volume over the 7 days before the cut-off)
SIZE.lv30: log(1 + BTC quote volume over the 30 days)
SIZE.ltr30: log(1 + mean trades per hour over the 30 days)
SIZE.lage: log(1 + days since the pair's first archive bar)

PRIOR.np: log(1 + listed pumps of this pair before the cut-off)
PRIOR.ds: log(1 + days since its last listed pump; 3650 when none)
PRIOR.anyp: 1 when it has a listed pump before the cut-off

TAPE.r1: log return over the last 1 h
TAPE.vr24: log((24 h volume + e) / (30-day mean daily volume + e))
TAPE.vr1: log((1 h volume + e) / (24 h mean hourly volume + e))
TAPE.vol7: standard deviation of hourly log returns over 7 days

features.notes: returns use closes at or before the cut-off; a feature that cannot be computed is 0 after standardisation; e = 1e-8 BTC; market capitalisation is not used (CoinGecko now needs a key)

models.fit: penalised logistic regression on candidate rows (the pumped pair = 1), TA_HISTORY_v1's fit(): standardised on the fold's fit rows, precision 16 on slopes, 1/1.5^2 on the intercept; nothing tuned; candidates ranked within each event by the fitted probability

metrics.top5: share of scored events whose pumped pair ranks in the model's top 5 (ties broken against the model)
metrics.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the pumped pair
metrics.delta: FULL - BENCH on the same events, pooled over the two folds by event count
metrics.uncertainty: bootstrap over event dates (clusters) within each fold, 2,000 resamples, seed 20261029; one-sided p for delta <= 0 = (resamples with pooled delta <= 0 + 1) / 2,001
metrics.brier: pooled Brier score on candidate rows, FULL against BENCH, reported beside it

decision_rule.beats_volume: Holm over the four at 0.05 rejects delta <= 0 and the Brier score of FULL is lower than BENCH's
decision_rule.otherwise: DOES NOT BEAT VOLUME for that test

descriptive: the coefficients of FULL per fold
use: a cut-off that beats volume is a candidate for a live crypto family (PLAN_v1 A4): the daily one could ride the existing 00:23 UTC crypto routine; the hourly one needs announced pump times (Telegram), the owner's decision. Nothing here changes any ledger, routine, register or frozen protocol
counted_trial: research/QUANT_GRADE/trials/CRYPTO_PUMP_HISTORY_v1.json (4 variants, Holm), its result in CRYPTO_PUMP_HISTORY_v1_result.json
limitations: the lists cover the groups those researchers watched, not every pump
Binance BTC pairs only; pumps moved to other venues after 2021
taking part in a pump is market manipulation; this is a paper study of prediction only
all events precede the sealed crypto holdout (2024 on)
